fact: The Tunisian Institute for Strategic Studies (ITES) published in November 2022 a study, 'La transition numérique en Tunisie à l'horizon 2050', written by named experts and addressed to the President of the Republic.

The Centre des Etudes Mediterraneennes et Internationales (CEMI), Tunis, published policy paper 1/2017 by Chawki Gaddes on the Tunisian process to raise personal data protection to European standards.
